# MermZen

Clean, ad-free online Mermaid diagram editor. No backend, no login, no ads.

URL: https://eric.run.place/MermZen/

## TL;DR for AI agents

To embed or share any Mermaid diagram, just URL-encode the Mermaid source and pass it as `?text=`.
No compression, no base64, no libraries needed.

```
Editor:   https://eric.run.place/MermZen/?text=<url-encoded mermaid>
Embed:    https://eric.run.place/MermZen/embed.html?text=<url-encoded mermaid>
```

Example — the diagram `graph TD; A-->B`:

```
https://eric.run.place/MermZen/embed.html?text=graph%20TD%3B%20A--%3EB
```

Drop that URL into an `<iframe>` and you have a live, pannable, zoomable diagram:

```html
<iframe src="https://eric.run.place/MermZen/embed.html?text=graph%20TD%3B%20A--%3EB"
        width="100%" height="500" style="border:none"></iframe>
```

## Opening / embedding a diagram via URL

There are two endpoints:

- `/` — the full editor (with code panel, themes, export)
- `/embed.html` — a minimal, transparent, pannable/zoomable view, designed for `<iframe>`

Both accept the same parameters.

### 1. Plain text (recommended — simplest, AI-friendly)

Pass the Mermaid source directly, URL-encoded. Aliases: `text`, `mermaid`, `diagram`.

```
/embed.html?text=sequenceDiagram%0AAlice->>Bob:%20Hi
```

Optional style query params (all optional):

| Param      | Values                                            | Default     |
|------------|---------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| `theme`    | `default`, `dark`, `forest`, `neutral`, `base`    | `default`   |
| `look`     | `handDrawn`, `classic`                            | `handDrawn` |
| `bg`       | `transparent`, `grid`, or any CSS color           | `transparent` |
| `font`     | `kalam`, `caveat`, `virgil`                       | `kalam`     |
| `fontSize` | integer px                                        | `16`        |

```
/embed.html?text=graph%20LR%3BA--%3EB&theme=dark&look=classic&bg=grid
```

### 2. postMessage (dynamic embeds)

The embed frame can be driven at runtime — no reload needed:

```js
const frame = document.querySelector('iframe');
frame.contentWindow.postMessage({
  type: 'mermzen:render',
  code: 'graph TD; A-->B',
  options: { theme: 'dark', look: 'classic' }
}, '*');
```

The frame posts messages back to the parent:

- `{ type: 'mermzen:ready' }` — frame loaded and listening
- `{ type: 'mermzen:rendered', width, height }` — render succeeded; use `height` to auto-size the iframe
- `{ type: 'mermzen:error', error }` — render failed

Auto-resize example:

```js
window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
  if (e.data?.type === 'mermzen:rendered') {
    document.querySelector('iframe').style.height = e.data.height + 'px';
  }
});
```

### 3. Compressed payload (compact, used by the Share button)

For long diagrams or to bundle settings into one short token, encode a JSON payload as
**pako deflate + base64** (URL-safe: `+`→`-`, `/`→`_`, strip `=` padding) and pass it as
`?code=` or as the hash (`#`):

```
https://eric.run.place/MermZen/?code={encoded}
https://eric.run.place/MermZen/#{encoded}
```

Payload format (v2):

```json
{ "v": 2, "c": "graph TD\nA-->B", "t": "dark", "hd": false, "hdf": "virgil", "hds": "large", "hdm": "random", "bg": "grid" }
```

Fields: `c` code (required); `t` theme; `hd` hand-drawn (false = classic); `hdf` font;
`hds` font size (`small`/`medium`/`large`); `hdm` seed mode; `bg` background.

JavaScript (with pako):
```js
const payload = { v: 2, c: "graph TD\nA-->B", t: "dark" };
const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(payload));
const compressed = pako.deflate(bytes);
let binary = '';
for (let i = 0; i < compressed.length; i++) binary += String.fromCharCode(compressed[i]);
const encoded = btoa(binary).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
const url = `https://eric.run.place/MermZen/#${encoded}`;
```

Python (zlib matches pako.deflate):
```python
import zlib, base64
def encode_code(code: str) -> str:
    b64 = base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(code.encode('utf-8'))).decode()
    return b64.replace('+', '-').replace('/', '_').rstrip('=')
url = "https://eric.run.place/MermZen/?code=" + encode_code(mermaid_code)
```

Decoding precedence in the embed: `?text=` wins; otherwise `#hash`/`?code=` is tried as a
compressed payload, and if that fails it is treated as URL-encoded plain text.

## Supported diagram types

flowchart, sequenceDiagram, classDiagram, stateDiagram-v2, erDiagram, gantt, pie, mindmap, architecture-beta, gitGraph, block-beta

## Features

- Live preview with 300ms debounce
- Export as SVG or PNG (2x resolution)
- 5 themes: default, dark, forest, neutral, base
- Hand-drawn style toggle
- Shareable URL via `?text=`, `?code=`, or `#hash`
- Embeddable `<iframe>` with postMessage API and auto-resize
